title: Australian special forces paid cash for US UAP retrieval operations

tellings.quote: And they told me they'd been involved in retrieval operations.

plain: Members of Australian special forces were paid in cash to help with American operations to recover crashed UAP, the official term for UFOs. That is the account of the journalist Ross Coulthart, who says the men told him themselves that "they'd been involved in retrieval operations." If true, it would mean the US recovers such craft and uses allied troops to do it.
